title: Law to require sexual assault plans at large public events
summary: This bill would require sponsors of large public events, generally those expecting more than 1,000 attendees or more than 500 with added risk factors, to submit sexual harassment and assault prevention and response plans before receiving a permit. Staff responders would need to complete training developed by the Police Department and Commission on Human Rights, and events would need to post signage or share information about reporting options. The law would take effect 120 days after enactment.
